pages.text: The $(bold)Bundled Cable$() carries $(italic)all sixteen colours at once$() in a single line — one cable for a whole control panel. Break it back out into coloured cables at the far end.
pages.title: Sixteen in One

pages.text: To see what's flowing inside one, the $(bold)Hexidecrubrometer$() reads a bundled cable and reports its combined value — your debugger for a tangle of channels.
pages.title: Hexidecrubrometer
